title: Recipe record (rcp_…)
description: How a dish is made (glossary: Recipe). Standalone and self-contained: components (other dishes, by content address) and operations (certified function records, by content address), each operation with its argument bindings and its AUTHORED world refinements (decision 34: refinements live in the recipe, keyed by operation); the retire steps; readiness declarations per resource class; create-only settings; and the dish's outputs. Internal wiring is the `bind` of each component and the bindings of each operation, fixed at authoring (R4, decision 18). Component names are derived from the dish's own name inputs by fixed rules (`derive`), which the instance generator applies and the provisioning command re-checks (decision 29). A recipe does not name its dish (the dish names it, decision 33). The recipe refers to the dish's declared inputs by name; publication checks that every referenced input is declared by the dish and that the dish's outputs are all produced. Unsigned.

names.description: One entry per name input of the component's dish, each a `derive` from one of this dish's name inputs.

placements.description: One entry per placement input of the component's dish, each an `input` of this dish.

wires.description: One entry per wire input of the component's dish: a `wire` (this dish's own input passed through) or a `component-output` / `operation-output` (internal wiring, frozen here).

components.description: Dishes this dish is composed from (decision 17). Each is used whole, never modified.

operations.description: The create steps. Order here is NOT the execution order: the planner orders steps from their refinements (R15).

retire.description: The delete steps, with their own refinements; scrub plans them in reverse dependency order (R19). Components retire through their own recipes.

class.description: The resource class whose readiness this declares.

probe.description: The read operation (a certified record) that observes the resource.

args.description: The probe's arguments, bound like any step's; they must ground at plan time.

ready_when.description: Which value of which field of the probe's result means `ready` (a database `state` equal to `RUNNABLE`).

limit_seconds.description: The wait obligation's time limit; a wait step that exceeds it is a named failure (decision 34).

readiness.description: How readiness is observed per resource class (design/proposals/01-ready-state.md). The planner turns a `ready` requirement no step ensures into a wait step over this probe (design/proposals/03-wait-steps.md).

create_only.description: Attributes of the dish's `provides` the cloud accepts only at creation (decision 7). Academic for replaceable environments; for a pet it is what makes a differing attribute an addition beside the old resource rather than a change.

outputs.description: One entry per output port of the dish: where its value comes from (an operation output, a component output, or a literal).

target.description: The certified operation this step applies.

args.description: Positional arguments, one per parameter of the target.

path.description: A path into the operation's result value (a `Just` payload is entered implicitly; a JSON-string result is parsed).

outputs.description: Named values this step yields for later bindings and for the dish's outputs.

binding.description: How an argument, a component input or an output gets its value. Kinds that ground at PLAN time (literals, names, placements, derived names, JSON built from those) are what world keys may use; kinds that ground at KITCHEN time (outputs of earlier steps, wires) may not appear in a world key.

oneOf.description: One of the dish's name or placement inputs, as a string (a `regions` placement as a list of strings).
One element of a `regions` placement input.
A fixed derivation from one of the dish's name inputs: the input's value followed by `suffix`. The only way a component or an inner resource is named (decision 29).
A field of one of the dish's wire inputs (kitchen time).
An output port of a component (kitchen time); `field` selects one field of a record-typed port.
A named output of an earlier step (kitchen time).
A JSON object built from bindings, rendered to a JSON string argument (the request-body idiom). A `body-field` world key reads a top-level field of it, which must itself ground at plan time.
A record value built from bindings, for a record-typed output port.
A JSON array built from bindings, inside a `json` body.
In a readiness declaration's probe args only: the i-th key value of the resource being waited on.

A value of the `secret` scalar type generated by the kitchen for this run, usable only as an argument to operations whose parameter has that type; never serialized (decision 31, design/proposals/05-secret-type.md).
